sexes.male: 머리꼭대기와 뒷목은 청회색이고 얼굴·멱·등은 검으며, 멱 아래쪽에 검은색으로 둘러싸인 흰 무늬가 있다. 날개에 길쭉한 흰 무늬가 있고 허리와 아랫면은 짙은 밤색이다.
sexes.female: 윗면은 적갈색 기 도는 올리브 갈색이고 허리와 꼬리 기부는 밤색이다. 아랫면은 갈색 기 도는 회색이며 멱에 흰 무늬가 있다.

young: 어린새는 암컷과 비슷하지만 윗면이 더 어둡고 담황색 반점이 많으며, 멱의 흰 무늬와 날개의 흰 띠가 훨씬 작거나 흐릿하다.

art.subject: White-throated Redstart (Phoenicurus schisticeps), adult male in spring: crown and nape blue-grey; sides of the head and throat black, with a sharply defined white patch in the centre of the lower throat; mantle and back black; wings black with a long white panel on the inner wing coverts of the folded wing; rump and uppertail coverts deep chestnut; tail mostly blackish; breast and flanks chestnut-rufous; centre of the belly whitish; vent and undertail coverts rufous; bill black, thin; eye dark; legs black.
art.pose: perched upright on a low shrub branch, side view, tail slightly lowered and quivering
art.scene: shrubby hillside edge near the coast of a Korean offshore island in early spring, bare twigs and dry grass in clear daylight; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male in spring, perched upright on a low branch, side view: slaty-blue crown and nape, black face and upper throat with a white patch on the lower throat, black mantle and wings with a long white band along the coverts, rufous breast and flanks, white lower belly, rufous vent, black tail, thin black bill and legs

adult male, perched, rear three-quarter view with head and body facing the same way: slaty-blue crown and nape, black back, black wings with a long white band, rufous rump and uppertail coverts, black tail

adult female, perched upright, side view: mainly brown plumage, white patch on the lower throat, long white band on the wing coverts, buffish-grey breast and belly, rufous rump, brown tail with rufous at the base of the outer feathers
art.build: A small, slim redstart about the size of a sparrow, similar in size and shape to Daurian Redstart. Round head, short neck and an upright stance. Bill short, thin and straight, much shorter than the head. Legs slender, black, of medium length. Wings fairly short, the folded wingtips falling well short of the tail tip. Tail fairly long and square-ended, frequently shivered and flicked downward as in other redstarts. Perches low on shrubs and rocks and drops to the ground for insects; in flight the chestnut rump and the white wing panel stand out.
avoid: Do not omit the white throat patch or make the whole throat white; the white is a small, sharply defined patch in the centre of a black throat.
Do not paint a silvery-white crown and only a small square white wing patch; that is Daurian Redstart (Phoenicurus auroreus), the common redstart in Korea.
Do not paint the whole underparts grey or white; the breast and flanks are chestnut-rufous, with only the centre of the belly whitish.
Do not add a white supercilium or white forehead.
